info.name: StepUpCRM API v1
info.description:
StepUpCRM REST API (`/v1/*`).

Two route files feed the single `/v1` mount:
- `routes/admin-v1.php` — staff API (`/v1/admin/*`), plus the shared `/v1/profile` and `/v1/notifications`.
- `routes/client-v1.php` — client portal API (`/v1/client/*`).

There is no `/api/*` prefix and no `/v2`.

## Setup
1. Import `stepupcrm-api.postman_environment.json` and select it.
2. Set `base_url` (default `https://llb.test`).
3. Run **Auth → Staff login** — the test script stores `{{token}}` automatically.
4. For portal endpoints run **Client Portal → Client login** — it stores `{{client_token}}`.

Collection auth is Bearer `{{token}}`; the Client Portal folder overrides it with `{{client_token}}`.

## Notes
- Every request sends `Accept: application/json`.
- List endpoints accept `search`, `page`, `per_page` (max 100), `sort`, `direction` (`asc`/`desc`). They are added as disabled query params — tick them in Postman to use them.
- Endpoints that accept a file (company logo, user/client image, profile image, payment proof, CSV import) use `multipart/form-data`. Updates with a file are sent as `POST` with `_method=put|patch`, which is what the React forms do.
- Call center `{order}` / `{orderItem}` ids are UUIDs on the `boneek` database.

item.name: Call Center
item.description: The `{order}` binding resolves against the **boneek** (inventory) database and is UUID-keyed. Editing endpoints run `OrderEditAccess` — the agent must be holding the order, the permission alone is not enough.

request.description:
Agent-settable statuses: `approved`, `cancelled`, `follow_up`, and `send_to_supplier` on a dropshipping order that is already `approved`.

`reason_type` / `reason_note` are **required** for `cancelled` and `follow_up`, and **prohibited** for `approved`.

Cancellation reasons: 1 customer unreachable, 2 payment issue, 3 changed mind, 4 not interested, 5 delivery issue, 6 out of area, 7 stock out, 8 price issue, 9 duplicate, 10 fake, 0 other.
Follow-up reasons: 1 switch off, 2 did not receive, 3 busy, 4 inform later, 5 talk to support, 0 other.
`reason_note` max 50 chars.
Scoped to the supplier the order already carries, and to orderable products only.
Adding a product already on the order tops up the existing line at the price it was sold at.
Whole units only — enforced on the endpoint, not just in React.
Removing the **last** item is refused — cancel the order instead.
A fixed discount above the subtotal is rejected outright.

request.description: Location ids are boneek uuids — fetch them from **Locations**.

`field` is `name`, `contact` or `tag`.
- `name` → `name`
- `contact` → `phone`, `alternative_phone`, `email`
- `tag` → `customer_tag_id`

Renaming the customer also renames their ledger account, mirroring inventory's `CustomerObserver`.
CRM-only (`call_center_activities`) — the merchant never sees it. Not behind the edit permission.
